headline_marked: PM Tareq Rahman [[urges UNOs to serve people]] with responsibility and humanity
headline: PM Tareq Rahman urges UNOs to serve people with responsibility and humanity
summary: The Prime Minister called on Upazila Nirbahi Officers to act as a bridge between the government and the people, emphasizing humanitarian service to the underprivileged.
details: Prime Minister Tareq Rahman called on Upazila Nirbahi Officers (UNOs) to work with maximum responsibility and humanity for the development of the country and the welfare of people during a meeting at the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, Dhaka.

He stated that the opportunity to serve people while in a state position is a great trust and a blessing from Allah, urging officials to stand by the underprivileged and ensure a safe and livable Bangladesh for future generations.

The Prime Minister emphasized that field administration officials serve as the bridge between the government and the people, and that UNOs should treat every citizen as their own, regardless of the where they are posted.
He noted that not all societal problems can be solved through laws alone, urging UNOs to be more active in creating public awareness to resolve issues effectively.
During the meeting, the Prime Minister praised and thanked 83 UNOs who honestly completed canal excavation projects and returned the surplus funds to the state treasury.

The meeting was attended by Public Administration Advisor Ismail Zabiullah, State Minister for Public Administration Abdul Bari, Cabinet Secretary Nasimul Gani, and the Chief Secretary of the PMO, ABM Abdus Sattar.
caption:
A call for humanity in administration: PM Tareq Rahman urges UNOs to be the bridge between government and citizens.

Prime Minister Tareq Rahman called on Upazila Nirbahi Officers (UNOs) to work with maximum responsibility and humanity for the development of the country and the welfare of people during a meeting at the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, Dhaka.

He stated that the opportunity to serve people while in a state position is a great trust and a blessing from Allah, urging officials to stand by the underprivileged and ensure a safe and livable Bangladesh for future generations.

The Prime Minister emphasized that field administration officials serve as the bridge between the government and the people, and that UNOs should treat every citizen as their own, regardless of the where they are posted.

He noted that not all societal problems can be solved through laws alone, urging UNOs to be more active in creating public awareness to resolve issues effectively.

During the meeting, the Prime Minister praised and thanked 83 UNOs who honestly completed canal excavation projects and returned the surplus funds to the state treasury.

The meeting was attended by Public Administration Advisor Ismail Zabiullah, State Minister for Public Administration Abdul Bari, Cabinet Secretary Nasimul Gani, and the Chief Secretary of the PMO, ABM Abdus Sattar.

headline: Jamaat-led 11-party alliance decides to contest presidential election
summary: The alliance aims to field an 'acceptable' candidate for the 23rd presidential race following the resignation of Md. Sahabuddin.
details: The 11-party alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami has made a policy decision to participate in Bangladesh's 23rd presidential election. A final decision regarding the candidacy will be made during an alliance meeting on Sunday, August 9.
caption:
Opposition alliance to enter the presidential race. Jamaat-led coalition seeks an 'acceptable' candidate for the Bangabhaban.

The 11-party alliance led by Jamaat-e-Islami has made a policy decision to participate in Bangladesh's 23rd presidential election. A final decision regarding the candidacy will be made during an alliance meeting on Sunday, August 9.
